genetic.notes: Employers may not request, require, or purchase genetic information about employees or applicants. Flat ban with narrow wellness exception. Drop the column or document an explicit GINA-compliant exception.

health.notes: Pre-offer medical inquiries or examinations prohibited. Permitted only after a conditional job offer.

disability.notes: Pre-offer disability inquiries prohibited; reasonable-adjustment discussion is allowed.

ethnicity.notes: Protected class. Collection lawful for EEO-1 monitoring or affirmative-action reporting only; never as a decision feature.

gender.legal_basis: Title VII (incl. Bostock v. Clayton County for orientation/identity)

age.notes: Protected for applicants/employees age 40+. Date of birth pre-hire creates ADEA risk; collect only when essential.

dob.notes: Same risk as age column; prefer post-hire collection.

pregnancy.notes: Cannot be a basis for hiring decisions; pre-hire questions create per-se Title VII risk.

marital_status.notes: Not a federal protected class but pre-hire inquiries treated as sex-discrimination proxies.

veteran_status.notes: Collectable; cannot be the basis of adverse action.

nationality.notes: I-9 collection lawful at hire; broader citizenship questions create national-origin-discrimination risk.

criminal_record.legal_basis: EEOC Enforcement Guidance 2012 (Title VII disparate-impact); state ban-the-box laws
criminal_record.notes: Federal disparate-impact risk; many states forbid pre-offer collection (see state-specific packs).

salary_history.legal_basis: No federal ban (state bans apply, see us-ca, us-ny, us-co, etc.)

photo.notes: Treated as a proxy for race/age/gender/national-origin; do not collect pre-hire.

name.notes: Necessary identifier, but flagged as proxy for ethnicity/gender by Pulse's proxy detector.

postcode.notes: Often a strong proxy for race/SES. Pulse's proxy detector should evaluate.
